name: Dakaria
source:
Seemingly an early 20's in vampire years, Dakaria is the first vampire met by MC [spoiler]and the last of her clan[/spoiler]. Unknown years after [spoiler]witnessing their slaughter at the hands of the Blood Circle[/spoiler], she seeks the allyship of a human with uncommon resolve to help her achieve justice and put an end to the vampires' bane.

Dakaria is the daughter of an ancient lineage who was once an aristocrat and lived "on the southern coast of France" with the rest of her house [spoiler]before the Circle's accusation and commencement of their slaughter.[/spoiler]

Though self-described as "beyond saving," she gives off the impression of being a kindhearted person.

[b]Body Type:[/b] Bottom Hourglass shape with thin arms, large breasts, thick thighs, and a big butt.
[b]Vampire Type[/b] [spoiler]non-pureblood daughter of an ancient lineage[/spoiler]
[b]Relations:[/b] Emma (friend [spoiler]since childhood[/spoiler]), Unknown ([spoiler]deceased lover[/spoiler]), Harkiva ([spoiler]ex-close childhood friend[/spoiler])
